function.name: fan_command
function.signature: signed char fan_command(signed char requested, signed char limit, unsigned char mode)

function_spec.expected_behavior: Select off, normal or boost behavior under the configured limit.

pre_condition.natural_language: The limit is in [0,100] and mode is 0, 1 or 2.

post_conditions.natural_language: A nonpositive request in normal mode returns zero.
Normal mode raises small positive requests to 20, subject to the limit.
Normal mode preserves a request of at least 20 within the limit.
Normal mode caps a request of at least 20 above the limit.

callee_expectations.expected_pre_nl: The caller permits every signed request and passes its original limit in [0,100].
callee_expectations.expected_post_nl: Apply the normal speed rule to the original request.
evidence: The mode 1 call passes requested and limit.

callee_expectations.expected_pre_nl: Both actual arguments are the limit in [0,100].
callee_expectations.expected_post_nl: For this callsite, return the limit including when it is zero or below 20.
evidence: The mode 2 call passes limit in both argument positions.

function.name: target_speed
function.signature: signed char target_speed(signed char requested, signed char limit)

function_spec.expected_behavior: Apply the normal speed rule and then cap the target.

post_conditions.natural_language: Raise small positive requests to 20, bounded by the limit.
Preserve requests of at least 20, bounded by the limit.
post_conditions.formal_candidate: (requested <= limit && result == requested) || (requested > limit && result == limit)

callee_expectations.expected_pre_nl: The nominal request is 20 and the limit is in [0,100].
callee_expectations.expected_post_nl: Return 20 if the limit permits it, otherwise return the limit.
evidence: The small-positive branch passes the constant 20.

callee_expectations.expected_pre_nl: The nominal request is at least 20 and the limit is in [0,100].
callee_expectations.expected_post_nl: Preserve the request when within the limit and cap it otherwise.
evidence: The final branch passes the original request.

function.name: limit_speed
function.signature: signed char limit_speed(signed char requested, signed char limit)

function_spec.expected_behavior: Clamp the request to the inclusive interval from zero to the limit.

post_conditions.natural_language: A request above the limit returns the limit.
